known_gaps: A failed unlink cannot guarantee physical removal of a local temporary file; the public loader rejects only the module-owned unpublished temporary namespace.
The repair does not claim to protect callers that deliberately parse retained temporary JSON outside the public loader or against arbitrary external filesystem tampering.
A directory fsync error after terminal publication remains a local durability uncertainty and does not prove survival across sudden host or filesystem loss.
The checks use temporary local files and controlled persistence seams; they do not perform Android, device, backend, model, oracle-service, or formal-run actions.
The repository-external historical fixture remains skipped by default; frozen M8, M9, and M9-R evidence was neither replayed nor changed.
